## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The two-fascicle alternative recension of the *Subāhu-paripṛcchā-sūtra* (companion to [KR6j0065](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0065) = T895a in three-fascicle form). The two recensions differ in length but share the core *kriyā-tantra* doctrinal-practical content.

**Abstract**

The two-fascicle recension represents an alternative or abbreviated arrangement of the same Tang Esoteric *kriyā-tantra* material. The Korean Tripiṭaka and the standard Taishō witnesses confirm it as a separate text-tradition. The translation dates from Śubhakarasiṃha's Chángān period (724–735).
